subtasks: Complete the equation by selecting the correct missing number or operator and placing it on the pad, then reset the robot arm.
Pick up the red digit 9 at the front left, just left of the plus candidate. Place the 9 upright in the center of the empty pad after the equals sign.

Retract the left arm. Use the right arm to pick up the upright red 9 at the midline just above the minus and multiplication candidates, and place it upright at the center of the empty answer pad after the equals sign.
Leave the completed equation 7 + 2 = 9 undisturbed. Fully open both grippers, lift the right fingers clear of the equation, and return both arms to the episode-start poses.
